purpose: Mechanism F exploratory test: RETRIEVAL_RANK_ANNOTATION, an unconditional (universal-precondition) response to the regime-mismatch lesson from Mechanisms D and E (Ledger Entries I, J).
excludes_note: all 41 units used anywhere in this arena to date (original 10 + Stage2's 10 + RAW_PROVENANCE's 8 + Mechanism D's 5 + Mechanism E's 8). _abs variants also excluded.

selection_rule.method: deterministic category quota (2 multi-session, 2 temporal-reasoning, 1 knowledge-update, 1 single-session-user, 1 single-session-assistant, 1 single-session-preference -- 8 total, covering all 6 categories since this mechanism has no category-specific precondition), first-by-question_id-sort within category after exclusion.
selection_rule.size_note: 8 units, matching RAW_PROVENANCE/Mechanism E's size -- this mechanism ALWAYS fires (unconditional annotation of every retrieved item), so unlike D/E there is no risk of a zero-trigger null; 8 gives reasonable statistical power for a clean BASE-vs-+F comparison.
